description: Day 1 first-impressions assignment. Go make other people smile: bring lightness/fun into an interaction so the first emotion someone feels around you is positivity. COC's first-impression model is to hit emotions in order, starting with positivity. Tied to the lesson 'How to Make Other People Smile' and 'Breaking Down a Great Introduction.'

Day 2 assignment on quickly building trust. Practice the two trust-builders taught that day: genuine honesty/vulnerability and appropriate touch. Say something honest or mildly vulnerable, and/or incorporate a brief, natural touch into a conversation, to make someone feel they can trust you fast.

Day 3 assignment on earning respect in any situation. Practice the day's respect-generating behaviors (including using conversational 'open loops' that hold attention) so people take you seriously while still liking you.

exercise_name: Action Guide: Asking The Right Questions
description: Day 4 assignment for connecting beyond small talk. Use higher-quality questions that move a conversation past facts toward emotions and meaning, hitting 'the right emotions in order.' Practice asking questions that get someone to open up rather than trading surface pleasantries.

exercise_name: Diagnose your charisma style (5 Styles of Charisma)
description: Day 5. Determine your natural style of charisma (built on Cabane's Focus / Visionary / Kindness / Authority types) and then plan to support and amplify that style rather than forcing a generic extrovert mold. Action Guide: Supporting Your Style of Charisma. Kindness/Focus are the introvert-friendly styles.

Day 6. Turn confidence on fast: (1) recall a time you felt great, (2) move your body the way you did then (posture/gesture), (3) repeat a punchy incantation to yourself. Uses the body's inner feedback loop to shift state on demand. Part of Action Guide: Incantations and Sentence Completions.

Day 6. Repeatedly finish an open-ended prompt many times to surface limiting beliefs and reframe them toward confidence (a classic Robbins-style sentence-completion drill). Paired with the incantations ritual. Exact prompts are gated; the technique is the named focus of the day.

exercise_name: Action Guide: Treating Your Fellow Humans
description: Day 7, building deep lasting confidence. Practice the day's fundamental confidence mindsets in how you treat others (e.g. 'you don't have to be confident all the time'); confidence is maintained through how you relate to people, not just self-hyping.

Day 8. Mentally rehearse an upcoming interaction going well, preparing for the best and expecting to be noticed, using three named visualization tips. A pre-event confidence-under-pressure drill done solo before a real situation.

exercise_name: Action Guide: Sharing Your Truth (honesty + courage)
description: Day 9, the foundation of unshakeable confidence. Practice saying the honest, slightly vulnerable thing you'd normally withhold — choosing courage over comfort. Honesty in conversation is framed as 'hard but worth it' and the bedrock of durable confidence.

exercise_name: Find patterns in your sentence completions (values/self-esteem)
description: Day 10. Review your accumulated sentence-completion answers and find the recurring patterns to map your real values and self-esteem; self-esteem is built on living your values. Antidote to feeling like 'a fraud.' Action Guide: Finding Patterns In Your Sentence Completions.

Day 11. Stop master-planning the 'perfect' line; deliberately say more of what comes to mind so conversation flows instead of freezing. COC's core conversation rule: speak with less filter. Directly targets the over-thinking that causes social paralysis. Action Guide: Lowering Your Inner Filter.

exercise_name: Speak through a smile + set up jokes (break the ice)
description: Day 12. Use comedic principles to make people laugh early and feel good around you: talk as if you're already amused/smiling, and practice setting up simple jokes. Lowers tension and speeds connection. Action Guide: Putting It Together.

Day 13. Identify what you actually care about so you can bring those values into conversation and connect 'one level deeper' than facts. Generating respect and connection by knowing and surfacing your own values. Action Guide: Creating Your Values.

Day 14. Connection is a two-way street: don't just extract others' values, share your own, with the right intent. Practice natural (not mechanical) mirroring and the day's practical conversation tips. Action Guide: Sharing Your Values.

exercise_name: Speak with a stranger (3 go-to starters)
description: Day 15, the flagship CU social challenge. Go start a conversation with a stranger using one of three go-to conversation initiators. A real-world exposure assignment to apply the whole conversation module live.

Day 16, storytelling kickoff. Build a personal story using CU's structure: find the overarching question/purpose underneath it, then structure it intentionally. The mindset is to calibrate to the audience, not race from A to Z. Action Guide: Crafting Your Story.

Day 17. Write an opening line that instantly grabs attention before you tell the story, plus knowing the right moment to start. Practice both conversational hooks and ready-to-use story hooks. Action Guide: Creating Your Hook.
Day 18. Building on a breakdown of Tony Robbins' storytelling and the two types of stories (funny vs purpose-driven), draft and tell a funny story of your own. Action Guide: Telling Your Funny Story.

exercise_name: Simplify your story / improvise a punchline
description: Day 19. Cut your story down to its essentials so you 'get to the punchline,' and practice landing the climax/moral. Tighten rising action so everything said serves the main point. Action Guide: Simplifying Your Story.

Day 20, storytelling capstone. Finalize your built-up story (hook, present-tense delivery, rising action, expanded climax, wrap-up/moral) and actually tell it to someone. Action Guide: Finishing And Telling Your Story.

Day 21. Maintain open, unguarded body language and remove closed postures that hurt charisma; confident people take up space and move with ease. Notice and correct common posture mistakes. Action Guide: Keep Yourself Open.

Day 22. Use micro-moments (elevator, checkout line, passing someone) to be fully present and share a genuine, infectious smile, bringing joy to small interactions without words. Action Guide: Catch Those Free 30 Seconds.

exercise_name: Try a new pose (magnetic body language + touch)
description: Day 23. Adopt a more expansive, magnetic posture/gesticulation pattern and practice brief 1-2 second touch to bond, making conversations more comfortable. Action Guide: Try A New Pose.

exercise_name: Take it up a notch (voice work)
description: Day 24. Improve your voice with one simple exercise: use your whole voice, ground it (lower, from the chest), and expand vocal range/dynamics instead of speaking monotone. Action Guide: Take It Up A Notch.

exercise_name: Finishing strong (authentic presence, stop seeking validation)
description: Day 25, the key to mesmerizing people. Bring authenticity to your 'performance' and stop seeking validation; show up as yourself rather than performing for approval. Action Guide: Finishing Strong.
Day 26, leadership. Lead by example and craft a vision others would actually want to follow; write/articulate that vision. Action Guide: Inspiring Life Exercise.

Day 27. Map the six core motivations that drive human action and identify what a specific person actually wants, then use that to get and hold their attention. A blueprint for getting people to do something. Action Guide: Understanding Needs.

Day 28. Conquer limiting beliefs, imposter feelings, and over-analysis by deciding quickly and giving a genuine compliment; counter fear and self-judgment with forgiveness and action. Action Guide: Decide And Compliment.
Day 29. Practice empathy and thinking like a leader by framing requests as win-wins, using short powerful persuasive phrases so both sides benefit. Action Guide: Creating Win-Win Situations.

exercise_name: Charisma in Groups: Finding the Seam
description: Bonus 'Charisma In Groups' module. Learn to spot and enter the 'seam' in a group conversation — the natural opening to join an existing group smoothly without being awkward or interrupting. Paired with a 5-day group-setting Action series.

exercise_name: Charisma in Groups: Active Listening + introductions
description: Bonus 'Charisma In Groups' module. Practice active listening in a group, deal with overwhelm, and run smooth introductions: introducing yourself, introducing others, and handling 'cliqueyness.' Drilled via the bonus Action – Day 1 through Day 5 assignments.

exercise_name: Work Relationships: connect with senior people
description: Bonus 17-part 'Work Relationships' module. Drills for forming relationships with senior/business contacts: foundational mindsets, in-conversation tactics, asking higher-quality questions, avoiding being a 'try hard,' building rapport with multiple people at once, damage control, public positive feedback, and taking relationships out of the office.

exercise_name: Dealing With Conflict: 5 mindsets + pre-conflict prep
description: Bonus 19-part 'Dealing With Conflict' module. Adopt five conflict mindsets, prepare before a conflict, use de-escalation/communication techniques, and apply resolution strategies to handle disagreements positively and turn adversaries into allies.
